about: Process plan for the Contour SLBEAM L-block on the shop's Hurco VM1 with a 6 in vise, following the shop's real routing (saw, Hurco mill, black oxide outside, QC). Written by Claude from the drawing (a modelled lookalike, in inches) and the STEP model; every feature below is checked against the model by moonshot/planning/validate.py. Model frame: X is length (the X=0 face is the back of the short leg), Y is width (1.500), Z is height (the Z=0 face is the bottom). The long leg is the 3.000 base and the short leg the 2.000 upright, each .750 thick. The bottom and both ends are faced while the blank is still a block, so the last setup cuts the L from finished faces: the back for X, the bottom for Z. The Hurco has no probe or tool setter in the shop record, so its X and Y are found with the edge finder and its tools measured on the presetter.

stock.material_note: As the drawing. The 1.500 width is left as the bar's own, cold-finished 1-1/2 in bar inside the drawing's ±.005; that is an assumption: squaring it from 1-3/4 in bar adds two setups
stock.from: sawn from the bar on the band saw

faces.-X: standing on the end of its long leg

operations.what: Cut the 3-1/4 in blank from the bar

workholding.note: The blank on 1 in parallels, 38 mm proud of the jaws; its sawn ends are free. The faced bottom is what both legs are measured from

wcs.x: the centre of the blank's length
wcs.by: edge finder in X and Y; Z touched off the top with the face mill

setups.title: Op 20: end of the long leg

workholding.note: Standing on its sawn back against the stop, still a full 57 x 38 mm block; check it's square with the indicator

operations.what: Face the long leg's end flat

workholding.note: Standing on the faced end against the stop; the threads are drilled from the back before the L is cut, past the short leg into stock the L removes, so the spiral-point tap pushes its chips into scrap

operations.what: Face the back to the 3.000 length
Drill 2X #7 (Ø.201) 1 in deep, through the short leg into stock the L removes
Tap both 1/4-20 through the short leg

workholding.note: On the faced bottom, on 1.25 in parallels so the L's floor stands 6.7 mm above the jaws; they hold 12 mm of the long leg

wcs.z: the bottom on the parallels, plus 2.000 in

operations.what: Face the top of the short leg to the 2.000 height
Rough out the L and finish both legs to .750 ±.002, the inside corner square (90° ±0°10')
Drill 2X K (Ø.281) through the long leg
Chamfer the short leg's two top edges

finish.what: Deburr every edge, breaking each one .005-.010 (note 1) with a hooked blade drawn along it, and clean the thread holes' exits into the L

finish.title: Send it out for black oxide
finish.what: Tag the part for black oxide and set it on the outside-process rack's coating shelf for the vendor
Black oxide all over, by the outside vendor, after machining (note 2)

finish.title: Check the legs, holes and threads
finish.what: Check both legs .750 ±.002 with the micrometer, the 3.000, 2.000 and 1.500 with the calipers, the inside corner square with the indicator on the height gauge, the Ø.281 holes with gauge pins, the 1/4-20 threads with a go/no-go gauge, and the black oxide all over
